segments.text: Day 162 · Metrics vs logs vs traces; cardinality traps, telemetry cost।
What: The three observability signal types, each suited to a different question, and the cardinality explosion (e.g.
per-user labels) that can silently blow up metrics storage cost.
How to complete: State which signal (metric, log, trace) you'd reach for to answer 3 different debugging questions, and name one label choice that risks a cardinality explosion.
